draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield — how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for the update — makes sense that getting everyone set up takes a little time. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier for the whole group.

Happy to walk through getting your team into your project and the work organized — want me to help with that this week? Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so it's a quick step once the team is in.

Best,
Priya
